description: This file defines an internal struct CommitQueue<T> which implements a circular buffer queue for transaction records, supporting operations like add, remove, clear, and search by timestamp and transaction ID.

classes.name: CommitQueue<T>
classes.description: A circular buffer queue for transaction records, maintaining order by timestamp and providing methods for adding, removing, and searching records.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a transaction record to the queue, resizing if necessary, and enforces timestamp order.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all transaction records from the queue.

methods.name: RemoveFromFront
methods.description: Removes a specified number of records from the front of the queue.

methods.name: RemoveFromBack
methods.description: Removes a specified number of records from the back of the queue.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Performs a binary search to find a transaction record by transaction ID and timestamp.
